posts.author: JohnDoeGames
posts.body:
You need to open an editor, like photoshop or gimp.
Then you need to edit the most left column out, because MZ uses 3 frames and the idle frame goes in the middle.
Make sure you cut off exactly 25% of the fill size from the left.
Then, when you save the file, make sure its filename starts with $
This will let the engine know it is only 1 character, instead of 8.
